main.OBJECTID: skip: GIS row identifier, no meaning for visitors
main.name: chart-host, table:directory, table:iso, kpi:pharm, insight:pharm, insight:mobile, insight:remote, map:map-main — site name after the fixed prefix line; classified by keyword into host types and shown in the directory and map popups
main.addr: table:directory, chart-city, kpi:cities, insight:leader, insight:singles, map:map-main — free-text address; the locality is recognised from it against a lexicon (then from the site name)
main.service: insight:services — comma-separated service list, rendered as the services chip list; identical for every row today
main.office: skip: constant (מערך הדיגיטל הלאומי); quoted once in the lede
main.X: map:map-main, chart-dist, kpi:near, insight:near, insight:remote, table:iso — ITM easting; one row has X/Y swapped and is corrected for distances
main.Y: map:map-main, chart-dist, kpi:near, insight:near, insight:remote, table:iso — ITM northing
